status: Geometric support screening; actual slicer cases are reported separately
orientation_reference: Additional rotations of the already print-oriented supplied STL

method.support_volume_meaning: Air column envelope under sampled overhangs, before support density, interface, XY expansion, branches or bridge treatment
method.short_gap_meaning: Support landing on the part in a gap below 6 mm; limited tool access flag, not proof of trapped support
method.stress_meaning: Nominal uniaxial traction fractions on the layer plane: normal=cos(theta)^2, shear=abs(cos(theta)*sin(theta)); no material strength or safety factor implied
